info.title: Student Support & Ticket Management
info.description: College Student Support Operations API for managing student tickets, assignments, SLAs, comments, resolutions, and audit history. Supports role-based access for ADMIN, STAFF, and STUDENT users, JWT authentication with Bearer tokens, UTC timestamps, and calendar-minute SLA calculations with consistent API error responses.

isActive.description: Deactivation is rejected until all assigned active tickets are transferred.

description.example: I need a bonafide certificate for my scholarship application.

studentId.description: Staff/admin must supply an active student ID; students may omit or supply their own ID.

effectiveResolutionDueAt.description: Deadline including the current unfinished student pause.

escalationLevel.description: 0 = none, 1 = at risk, 2 = breached; highest level reached in current cycle

assignedTo.description: Active STAFF or ADMIN user. Staff may claim unassigned tickets or transfer tickets they own.

priority.description: Recalculates deadlines from the current cycle start, preserving elapsed time and pauses.

status.description: Only these work states are accepted. Use dedicated resolve, close, reopen and cancel endpoints.

reason.description: Required for both pending states. Visible to the student.

resolutionNote.example: Certificate issued and ready for collection.

reason.example: The requested certificate still contains an incorrect name.

message.example: My student ID has now been verified.

internal.description: Staff/admin only; hidden from students and does not count as a first response.

responseMinutes.description: Response deadline in calendar minutes; applies to new/reopened/reprioritized tickets.

resolutionMinutes.description: Must be at least responseMinutes. Existing tickets retain their SLA snapshot.

escalated.description: Number of new escalation events recorded.

breached.description: Active tickets whose current response or resolution SLA is breached.

averageResolutionMinutes.description: Mean current-cycle resolution time excluding student pauses; null if no resolved tickets.
